what: In a vertical thumbnail column, the closer a cell is to the screen center, the more it is pushed out sideways — if the distance d from the center is within 280px, the offset is (1 − d/280)² × 64px, followed at .08 per frame so it swells smoothly. The nearest cell gets is-active and fires fx:active (cell index) to change the big center photo. For a horizontal column (axis: x) it moves up 24px (within 220px)

options.max: Max push distance (px), default 64 (24 for horizontal rows)
options.range: Push distance (px), default 280 (220 for horizontal row)
options.lerp: Share followed each frame, default .08 — 0 means no movement, 1 means instant
options.axis: If x, horizontal lines — pushed upward relative to the horizontal center of the screen
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Thumbnail cell — shifted by CSS translate, so it lives together with the cell’s transform (the entrance motion)

note: Cell positions are measured every frame, so hundreds of cells get heavy (original gallery 20~60 images)

from.where: detail.html .gal__thumbs (original Gallery() — within a center distance of 280px (phone 220) (1−d/280)²×64 (phone 24), lerp .08, the nearest cell gets is--active → center photo)
